You wouldn't believe the secrets he knows.|Sabine Wren, Hondo Ohnaka, and Zeb Orellios|}} '''Terba''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Ugnaught]] who previously worked at [[Reklam Station]] but was arrested after he tried to escape from the station. At some point after his arrest, Terba and the [[Weequay]] [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] ended up in a [[Naraka prison|prison]] on the [[planet]] [[Naraka]]. In [[2 BBY]], the pair was [[Rescue of Hondo Ohnaka|rescued]] by the [[Spectres|crew]] of the ''[[Ghost]]''. However, Terba [[Death|died]] in the prison escape, shot by an [[All Terrain Defense Pod|AT-DP]]. ==Biography== Terba was a [[Gender|male]] [[Ugnaught]] who lived during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[2 BBY]],''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow'' seventeen [[Standard year|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events of ''Steps Into Shadow'' must take place in [[2 BBY]]. he worked as a laborer at the Imperial junkyard [[Reklam Station]] which lay inside the [[gas]] [[planet]] of [[Yarma]]. He and his fellow Ugnaughts including [[Melch]] were used to dismantle various [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[starfighter]]s including [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing starfighters]]. Terba tried to escape but was captured and sent to the [[Naraka prison|Imperial prison]] on [[Naraka]]. There, he met the [[Weequay]] [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and told him about the Imperial operations at Reklam Station. Hondo, who had been [[Prison|imprisoned]] by the Empire following a [[Skirmish in Nixus Hub 218|skirmish]] at [[Nixus Hub 218]], contacted the [[Spectres]] and convinced them to help in return for sharing this information. Several members of the [[Phoenix Cell]] led by the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] [[Rescue of Hondo Ohnaka|raided]] the prison and rescued Hondo and Terba. The rebels particularly [[Sabine Wren]] were reluctant to rescue a second person until Hondo assured them that Terba knew secrets that were vital to the rebellion. During the escape attempt, Terba demanded a double share but was rebuffed by Hondo, who called him a "greedy little [[pig]]." Snubbed, Terba broke free of the group and fled outside the prison only to be blown sky high by an Imperial [[All Terrain Defense Pod|AT-DP]] [[walker]]. Despite his death, Hondo shared the information on Reklam Station with the Phoenix Squadron. Following Terba's death, [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] realized that the Phoenix rebels were going to attack Reklam Station after realizing that Terba had been Hondo's cellmate on Naraka. During the rebels' [[Mission to Reklam Station|mission]] to Reklam Station, Hondo was able to convince the other Ugnaughts including Melch to assist them by telling them that he was a friend of Terba. ==Personality and traits== As an Ugnaught, Terba had a diminutive physique, [[porcine]] features, and spoke [[Ugnaught (language)|Ugnaught]]. He was an opportunist and only shared information about Reklam Station to Hondo Ohnaka in return for financial gain and freedom. When Hondo refused to give him a double share of the reward, Terba abandoned his companion. In his eagerness to escape from Naraka prison, Terba was fatally hit by [[laser]] [[fire]] from an Imperial AT-DP walker. ==Behind the scenes== Terba first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'', which premiered on [[Disney XD]] on [[September 24]], [[2016]]. He was voiced by [[Jim Cummings]], who also voiced the character Hondo Ohnaka. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Terba}} *{{StarWarsShow|Qe3LSQiMJUk|Star Wars Rebels Season 3 Clip, Gareth Edwards Interview, and More!|sw_url=video/the-star-wars-show-episode-10}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars: List It!|text=8 of the Best Buddies in Star Wars|video=a8pt85FAJuc|nolive=1}} *{{Databank|terba|Terba}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ターバ |pl=Terba }} [[Category:Individuals enslaved by the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Ugnaughts]]
